### Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `EarPair-0.2.4-win-x64-setup.exe` | The Windows app for most PCs. Run it to install. |
| `EarPair-0.2.4-win-arm64-setup.exe` | The same for Arm PCs. |
| `EarPair-0.2.4-macos-universal.dmg` | The Mac app, for Intel and Apple silicon. Open it and drag `EarPair` to Applications. |

### What's new

- The PC reconnects by itself when the Mac's or the PC's local IP address changes, for example after switching Wi-Fi networks. Before, it could keep sending to the old address until EarPair was restarted.
- Windows setup can install for all users (in Program Files, asks for administrator rights) or just for you, and lets you choose the folder on the first install. Updates keep the choice. To move an existing install to all users, uninstall it first.
- Both apps can stop checking for updates automatically: **Check for updates automatically** in the PC's window or in setup, and on the Mac's **Connection** page. Checking by hand still works.
- Windows setup shows how EarPair uses the network before installing. See also the new [privacy policy](https://github.com/milkman-wang/EarPair/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).
- Spatial audio on the Mac explains why it can't start (no head data, motion access denied) instead of waiting, and no longer asks for head-tracking AirPods while it waits for the PC.
- The Mac app only updates to versions that run on that Mac.
- The PC app no longer crashes when **Enter address** is opened twice, no longer re-mutes speakers you unmuted with the volume keys, and keeps 5.1 and 7.1 sound from clipping.
- Uninstalling on the PC removes EarPair's logs, downloaded updates and its install folder.
- On both computers, 0.2.3 offers this update by itself.

### 下载

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `EarPair-0.2.4-win-x64-setup.exe` | Windows 版，大多数电脑用这个。运行即可安装。 |
| `EarPair-0.2.4-win-arm64-setup.exe` | Arm 电脑用这个。 |

### 更新内容

- Mac 或电脑的局域网 IP 变了（比如换了 Wi-Fi）时，电脑会自己重新连上。以前可能一直发到旧地址，直到重启 EarPair。
- Windows 安装程序可以为所有用户安装（装到 Program Files，需要管理员权限），也可以只为自己安装；首次安装时可以选择安装位置。更新时沿用之前的选择。已经装好的想改成为所有用户安装，请先卸载。
- 两端都可以关掉自动检查更新：电脑上在窗口或安装程序里的 **自动检查更新**，Mac 上在 **连接** 页。手动检查照常可用。
- Windows 安装程序在安装前说明 EarPair 如何使用网络。另见新的[隐私政策](https://github.com/milkman-wang/EarPair/blob/main/PRIVACY.md)。
- Mac 上的空间音频启动不了时（没有头部数据、没给运动权限）会说明原因，不再一直等；等电脑连接时也不再提示需要支持头部追踪的 AirPods。
- Mac 只会更新到能在这台 Mac 上运行的版本。
- 电脑上连续打开两次 **输入地址** 不再崩溃；用音量键取消的静音不会再被重新静音；5.1、7.1 声音不再削顶。
- 在电脑上卸载时会一并删除 EarPair 的日志、下载的更新和安装文件夹。
- 两台电脑上的 0.2.3 都会自己提示这次更新。
